name: – Isabel Wiseler-Lima – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: REPORT on human rights and democracy in the world and the European Union’s policy on the matter – annual report 2024
part_text:
The European Parliament sets out its yearly position on human rights and democracy in the world. It is not a law. It calls on the EU to put human rights at the centre of its foreign policy, to use sanctions against abusers, to protect activists and journalists, and to defend women's rights, children, refugees, disabled people and minorities. It also asks the EU to support the International Criminal Court and to push back against authoritarian governments.

- **What changes:** nothing directly; it is Parliament's opinion and set of requests to the EU.
- **Who it affects:** EU foreign policy, aid and trade, and people facing rights abuses worldwide.
- **What happens next:** the EU institutions decide whether to act on these requests.
